program:
app "Ludo" dice ocean
table point team pick Red|Blue, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Red)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Blue)
setting winat num = 50 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Red" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Red, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Red, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Blue" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Blue, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Red win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Blue win!" head color good
describe:
Ludo, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Red, Blue; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 50.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Red.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Blue.
Shows:
- text: "Red".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Red, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Red, pts set to 2.
- text: "Blue".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Blue, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Blue, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:

- if b is at least winat:

program:
app "Sleep Clock" bed plum
setting bed time = 23:00 "Bedtime"
setting wake time = 7:00 "Wake-up time"
let a = 360 * (((bed - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
let b = 360 * (((wake - 0:00) / 1h) % 12) / 12
draw width 220
  circle 50, 50, 46 stroke edge thick 1
  arc 50, 50, 38, a, if(b > a, b, b + 360) stroke accent thick 6
  label 50, 8, "12" tiny
  label 92, 52, "3" tiny
  label 50, 96, "6" tiny
  label 8, 52, "9" tiny
  label 50, 50, ((wake - bed) / 1h + 24) % 24 big
"Bedtime" bed "Wake-up" wake head
describe:
Sleep Clock, in the plum colours.
You can change: "Bedtime": time of day, starts at 23:00; "Wake-up time": time of day, starts at 7:00.
Works out:
- a is 360 times the result of the result of the result of bed minus 0:00 divided by 1 hour leaves over when divided by 12 divided by 12.
- b is 360 times the result of the result of the result of wake minus 0:00 divided by 1 hour leaves over when divided by 12 divided by 12.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels.
- text: "Bedtime", bed, "Wake-up", wake.

program:
app "Cricket" ball slate
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool, out bool
setting overs num = 20
let legal = count(ball today where wide = no)
let runs = sum(ball.runs today) + count(ball today where wide = yes)
let wkts = count(ball today where out = yes)
runs "/" wkts big
"Overs" floor(legal / 6) + legal % 6 / 10 "of" overs ". Run rate" round(runs * 6 / legal) faint
row gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 1
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Out" fill bad tap add ball out = yes
  button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
"Last balls" faint
row gap 1
  each ball today sort at desc top 6
    draw width 36
      circle 50, 50, 46 fill if(it.out, bad, if(it.runs >= 4, good, soft))
      if it.out
        label 50, 50, "W" bold
      else
        label 50, 50, it.runs bold
describe:
Cricket, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; wide: yes or no; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: overs: number, starts at 20.
Works out:
- legal is how many ball entries today where wide is no.
- runs is the total runs of ball today plus how many ball entries today where wide is yes.
- wkts is how many ball entries today where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: runs, "/", wkts.
- text: "Overs", legal divided by 6 rounded down plus legal leaves over when divided by 6 divided by 10, "of", overs, ". Run rate", runs times 6 divided by legal rounded.
- for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
  - a button the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "Wide"; a tap adds a ball with wide set to yes.
- a button "Out"; a tap adds a ball with out set to yes.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest ball entries today, with undo.
- text: "Last balls".
- for each ball today sorted by at, highest first, first 6:
  - a drawing made of circles, labels.

program:
app "Milk" milk mint
table customer name text, rate money "Rate per litre"
table delivery customer ref customer, litres num 0..
table payment customer ref customer, amount money
"Money due" sum(customer, sum(it.delivery, it.litres) * it.rate - sum(it.payment.amount)) big
each customer as c
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name bold grow
      "Due" sum(c.delivery, it.litres) * c.rate - sum(c.payment.amount) bold
    "Today" sum(c.delivery.litres today) "litres" faint
    row gap 1
      each [0.5, 1, 2] as v
        button v "L" tap add delivery customer = c, litres = v
      button "Paid" tap edit c
form customer, "Add customer"
form payment, "Add payment"
list delivery by day

- text: "Money due", the sum of the sum of its litres over the its delivery times its rate minus the total amount of its payment entries over the customer.
